records.query: 统计华东地区 2025 年第一季度的销售总额
records.resolved_query: 统计华东地区 2025 年第一季度的销售总额
records.sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS 销售总额 FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dr.region_name = '华东' AND dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter = 'Q1' LIMIT 1000
